form_analysis.feedback: Straightforward aftercare for a gentle, non-invasive treatment. Focuses on maintaining the post-facial glow, enhancing oxygenation, and protecting the skin. Appropriately simple with minimal restrictions.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice will help you maintain the radiant glow, improved circulation, and deep hydration achieved during your oxygen treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this simple aftercare to extend the benefits of your facial.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin will have an immediate glow, look plump, and feel incredibly smooth and hydrated. There is typically no downtime. Any mild pinkness will fade within an hour.

sections.title: Maximising the Oxygen Boost
items: Do not wash your face for at least 4-6 hours to allow the nutrient-rich serums to fully absorb.
Continue to support circulation: gentle facial massage, moderate exercise, and deep breathing are beneficial.
Stay well-hydrated by drinking plenty of water to support cellular function and the oxygen transport system.

sections.title: Product Use
sections.content: You may resume your normal skincare routine immediately. To build on the treatment, consider using antioxidant serums (like Vitamin C or E) which work synergistically with oxygen to protect the skin.

sections.title: Sun Protection
sections.content: While your skin is not sensitised, maintaining a healthy glow requires sun protection. Apply a broad-spectrum SPF daily to prevent UV damage from undoing the brightening effects.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
sections.content: There are no strict restrictions. However, to avoid clogging the freshly cleansed pores, it's advisable to avoid heavy, greasy makeup and excessively sweaty activities for the remainder of the day.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: You may apply makeup immediately if desired. Your makeup will likely apply more smoothly over your hydrated skin.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: Adverse reactions are extremely rare. Contact your therapist if you experience any unusual irritation or rash.
The intense glow and hydration can last 3-5 days. Regular treatments (monthly) are recommended for cumulative brightening and anti-ageing benefits.
This is an excellent treatment before special events for an instant radiant effect.

patient_declaration.question_opportunity: Please let your therapist know if you have any questions or if you do not understand any of the aftercare instructions provided below.
patient_declaration.declaration_text: I confirm that I have read and understood all the information on this Form and that I have been given the opportunity to ask any questions that have come to mind throughout.
